text: No one severed the Loom. It was pulled from nine sides, and this Codex cannot say which thread gave first. Neither could the tribes, by the end. One moment the sky was a floor. The next, the agreements failed in the same breath.
The Pad-keepers felt it first: hearths went cold while the sky still looked whole. Then the Rootbinders' living anchors held for a season, and that season is why anything is still up here.
Guardians snapped in their arenas. Songs kept playing with nobody to hear them. Gate-paths stayed open into nowhere.
It was a knot coming undone. Continents fell in the space of a drum-roll. What did not fall is a pad of earth the Strands still remember. You are standing on leftovers that learned how to be a floor.
